cohort: The study included 484 term liveborn infants with a 1-minute Apgar score of 1, 2, or 3 followed by a 5-minute Apgar score of ≥7.
finding: Low 1-minute Apgar scores (1, 2, or 3) followed by a 5-minute Apgar score of ≥7 were not associated with neurologic abnormalities or developmental delay up to 12 months of age.
